commandOrSteps: Run node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run src/features/auth/api/auth-api.test.ts src/app/contexts/AuthSessionProvider.test.tsx. For browser verification, set VITE_DATA_SOURCE=api, VITE_API_BASE_URL=https://e2e.test, and VITE_WS_URL=wss://e2e.test; start local Vite at http://127.0.0.1:4189; run node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test --config=playwright.u01-03-local-temp.config.mjs. The temporary one-worker Desktop Chrome config selected tests/e2e/auth-session.spec.ts and returned status-only HTTP 401 for GET /auth/session. Run both TypeScript no-emit projects, focused ESLint/Prettier, OpenAPI, dependency-cruiser, architecture inventory, lint budget, EOL, tracking, and git diff checks. The temporary config was removed and Vite was stopped after the run.
environment: Windows 11; Node v24.19.0; Vitest v4.1.11; @playwright/test 1.63.0; Vite 6.4.3; Chromium 153.0.8010.12; local Vite API mode and MSW node test server; backend and staging disconnected.
expected: GET /auth/session may return 200 with a session or null, or the contract-declared 401 when no valid session exists. The adapter must resolve 401 as null so AuthSessionProvider enters unauthenticated state without reporting a session-loading error. Transport failure must remain an error.
actual: Before the change, createAuthApi.getSession propagated the contract-declared 401, causing AuthSessionProvider to enter error state and capture it as a session-load exception. It now catches only ApiError status 401 and resolves null; other errors are rethrown. The adapter tests verified 401 resolves null and HttpResponse.error() still rejects. Focused Auth API plus AuthSessionProvider suites passed 36/36. The combined auth-session Playwright suite passed 16/16; the new browser case returned a status-only 401 for GET /auth/session and confirmed the guest login page renders without an auth error or sign-out control. Both TypeScript no-emit projects and focused ESLint/Prettier passed. OpenAPI passed (15 contracts/154 operations); dependency-cruiser passed (863 modules/4,680 dependencies, 0 violations); architecture inventory passed (129 pages/427 routes/149 components/32 services/28 mocks); lint budget passed (0 errors/0 warnings); EOL passed (3,224 paths/0 missing line terminators); git diff --check passed. check-tracking exited 1 with 75 source-ledger errors: 32 missing catalogued hashes, 5 paths absent from cataloguedSourceHead, 37 current source mismatches, and 1 historical change missing beforeHash; exact application inventory is 916/916. One current source mismatch is the updated auth-api.ts compared with the historical cataloguedSourceHead.
notes: This confirms frontend normalization of the contract-declared 401 using local MSW and Playwright fixtures. It does not establish cookie persistence, backend or staging behavior, production readiness, or user acceptance. Only status 401 is normalized; transport errors continue to surface as errors. The source-ledger checker remains red for historical snapshot drift and the current auth-api.ts hash. The separate registration verifyMfa security-owner decision remains unresolved.
